title: Document the skill-vs-knowledge boundary so BC facts land in knowledge files
summary: Documentation now clarifies that skills should contain mechanics while knowledge files hold Business Central facts, establishing a boundary to prevent facts from being duplicated or misplaced across skills and knowledge articles.
key_points: Skills are finders/appliers that act on cited BC behavioral claims from knowledge files, not containers for BC facts
Negative knowledge (false-positive guards) is first-class and belongs in knowledge files, not inline in skills
New decision gate in write.md helps authors determine whether a knowledge file is the right artifact
Reviewer heuristic added: changes to what skills flag should almost certainly go into knowledge files
Rule against restating article facts inline in skills prevents duplication and drift
quote: nothing tells an author where a new BC fact (or a false-positive guard) belongs
